entities.name: PMID:25444147
observations: In 278 hospitalized community-acquired pneumonia patients, platelet activation markers were higher among patients with MI; several markers independently predicted MI in regression. Observational results do not establish causality or MI subtype.

entities.name: PMID:29577968
observations: In a hospitalized CAP cohort, urinary 11-dehydro-TxB2 was assessed as an in-vivo platelet activation marker and 31 patients developed MI; available abstract details do not provide the MI-group comparison effect estimate.

entities.name: CAP platelet activation and MI
observations: Observational CAP studies suggest platelet activation markers are associated with MI during hospitalization, but available evidence does not establish causality or distinguish type 1 from type 2 MI.
